findings.scope: proposal/interface completeness, not a demonstrated production vulnerability
findings.observation: Existing Transaction and GuardInTx do not observe UTC values scanned through A bootstrapWork or resource callbacks using the caller raw *sql.Tx. A private D clock tracker alone cannot establish a floor for these A observations.
findings.required_resolution: Define the shared bounded SQL-time sampling capability used by every authoritative A/D sample. Capture each successful sample in the same tx/context floor; close any external sampling capability with work while internal final sampling remains possible. Do not claim all raw SQL clock reads are automatically intercepted.
findings.counterexample: Initial D T0, A callback validates later T2, final D T1 with T0<=T1<T2 must reject and roll back all A/D writes. Include failure/cancellation sampling and no post-final callback.

findings.scope: proposal phase order, not an implemented defect
findings.observation: If Prepare or L1 requires an open domain, fresh old observation or unchanged live current-run before L3 identifies a matching prior success, the documented historical retry cannot reach its read-only branch after lawful epoch close or observation expiry.
findings.required_resolution: Before L3, authenticate current bootstrap read/operation identity and bind retained original selection without requiring new-consume freshness/open state. At L3 select exact prior-success readback versus first consume; enforce original fresh observation/open domain/current target only in first-consume branch. Original mappings and request hash remain exact; no latest-run reconstruction or fresh probe.
findings.counterexample: After successful consume with closed epoch and expired old observation, same original operation/mapping under current A authority returns original result with no consume/CAS/charge/activation. Changed hash or revoked current A authority rejects.

additional_contract_notes: Candidate/config/set digest correspondence may apply only where the original trusted domain profile proves the exact A canonical byte algorithms; do not reinterpret older persisted admissions.
Original ResultBinding.GrantVersion is absent from ReceiptRecord; original execution snapshot cannot be reconstructed from caller-added fields.
No new delete primitive is needed to retain the three original references; preserving them must not invent a capacity release.
